homeAbout.title: More Than Events,
homeAbout.body: At Forever Events, we believe every event tells a story. Our mission is to make event planning simple, enjoyable, and unforgettable — by connecting you with trusted vendors and handling the details, so you can focus on what truly matters.

homeHow.title: Plan Your Event
homeHow.step1Text: Find the perfect services for your event.
homeHow.step2Text: Select your vendors and share your details.
homeHow.step3Text: We handle the rest while you create unforgettable memories.

aboutPage.title: Forever Events,
aboutPage.lead: We begin in Oran, with one wish: to make planning an event simpler, more beautiful, and more human.
aboutPage.p1: Today, finding a photographer, decorator, DJ, venue or makeup artist often means searching everywhere: Instagram, WhatsApp, word of mouth. Forever Events gathers curated vendors in one place.
aboutPage.p2: This is not just a directory. We select the vendors, you build “My Event”, then you send us a single request. Our team takes care of the human coordination.
aboutPage.p3: A beautiful, clear platform built for Oran: you choose, we coordinate, and you stay focused on the day itself.
